# Dashy

Dashy is an Obsidian plugin: a dashboard inside a note, built from seven
markdown blocks (today, tiles, stats, progress, countdown, heatmap,
chart) configured in YAML. No JavaScript, no Dataview. It reads frontmatter
through Obsidian's own metadata cache and writes nothing to your notes
unless you ask it to.

A block counts over a window: the current week, month or year, a rolling
count of days like `30d`, the period the note it sits in is named for
(`period: note` on stats, progress and a tiles count badge, `range: note`
on chart and heatmap, for a weekly or monthly review note like `2026-W40`
or `2026-10`), a period written out (`2026-Q4`) or two dates
(`{ from: 2026-09-01, to: 2026-09-30 }`). A note is dated by its name
(`YYYY-MM-DD`, the day format of the Daily notes or Periodic Notes
settings, or a block's own `date_format`, like `DD.MM.YYYY`) or by a
frontmatter property named in `date_field`.

Site: https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/
Repository: https://github.com/Dimagious/dashsidian
Community plugin listing: https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/dashsidian
Plugin id: dashsidian

## For AI agents

Dashy is meant to be written by an agent: the user describes the dashboard,
the agent reads the vault and writes the blocks. Read the skill first, then
the key tables of the block you are writing:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dimagious/dashsidian/master/docs/SKILL.preview.md
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dimagious/dashsidian/master/docs/reference.preview.md
(In the skill preview, the link to `reference.md` means this second file.)

## Guides

Step-by-step pages, one problem each, with YAML to copy:

- All guides: https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/
- Build an Obsidian dashboard with an AI agent (install the skill or
  AGENTS.md from Dashy's settings, open the vault in Claude Code, Codex or
  Cursor, and six requests in plain words with the blocks they produce):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/ai-agent-dashboard/
- A habit tracker in Obsidian without Dataview (checkbox properties in daily
  notes become counts, streaks, this week against last, and a year heatmap):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/habit-tracker-without-dataview/
- A habit streak that skips weekends (`days: weekdays` and `skip_field` on
  `current_streak` and `streak`):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/streak-weekdays/
- Two activities on one heatmap (`layers`, one colour each; on a day with
  both, the first layer's colour shows, or the larger value with `pick: max`):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/heatmap-two-activities/
- A monthly habit calendar without Dataview (`heatmap` with `range: month`
  and `layout: calendar`: day numbers, a dot per habit with `layers`;
  `range: week` for one row, `skip_field` for days off):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/monthly-habit-calendar/
- A weekly review in Obsidian without Dataview (`period: note` on `stats`
  and `range: note` on `chart` and `heatmap` count the week or month the
  note is named for, like 2026-W40; `compare: true` against the whole
  week before, `compare: usual` against your usual level):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/weekly-review-without-dataview/
- A weekly chart without Tracker (`chart` with `bucket: week` and `goal`;
  `dashy-chart` next to Obsidian Charts; frontmatter only):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/weekly-chart-tracker-alternative/
- An Obsidian homepage dashboard without code (`today` with `clock`, `stats`
  with `layout: inline`, folder `tiles` with `badge: count`, `countdown`):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/homepage-dashboard/
- Countdown to a birthday (`countdown` with `field` and `repeat: yearly`, the
  age on the card, expiry dates read from a note):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/countdown-birthday/
- Books per year, a reading log chart (`chart` with `bucket: year` and
  `date_field`, `stats` with `period: year` and `compare`):
  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/guides/books-per-year/

- Block reference, every key of every block with defaults and synonyms,

  https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/reference/

  - chart: https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/reference/chart/

  - tiles: https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/reference/tiles/
  - countdown: https://dimagious.github.io/dashsidian/reference/countdown/

  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dimagious/dashsidian/master/README.md
- Changelog:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dimagious/dashsidian/master/CHANGELOG.md
- Agent skill: how an agent writes Dashy blocks (look, pick, write, check):
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dimagious/dashsidian/master/docs/SKILL.preview.md
- Agent skill reference of every block key, generated from the block schema:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dimagious/dashsidian/master/docs/reference.preview.md
- JSON schema of every block key:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dimagious/dashsidian/master/docs/dashy.schema.json
